project.title: PAS - Photo Acquisition Service SaaS Cloud Application
project.role: IT Infrastructure and Cloud Services Manager

parentsummary.deliverables: Architected and delivered a market-pioneering SaaS platform on AWS and RackSpace providing on-demand aerial imagery and roofing engineering metrics to US insurance companies, encompassing RBAC access control design, CI/CD pipeline integration, compliance alignment to ISO:27001, NERC, FISMA, and NIST, and full go-live.
parentsummary.outcomes: Deployed a production SaaS platform achieving 99.5% uptime and serving 500+ global insurance company clients across 15 countries, establishing GeoDigital as a market leader in remote property assessment services.

challenge.summary: GeoDigital created a market pioneering SaaS application utilized by premium US insurance companies to provide a Photo Acquisition Service (PAS) system to provide on-the-fly imagery and extrapolated engineering metrics for roofing claims.

deliverables: Project managed and deliverables tracked with Agile Project methodologies and Sprint based cadences
Needs analysis, define requirements, and identify cloud provider (AWS & RackSpace)
Security Coordination and alignment to required Guidelines (NERC, FISMA & NIST)
Implementation of IT Security and Cyber Protection Controls. Compliance required for ISO:27001, NERC and NIST
Partnered with R&D team and flagship early-adopter insurance client to define SaaS product workflows
Established the SaaS platform access control framework defining RBAC roles
Staged build and deployment of cloud infrastructure and on-premise infrastructure
Internal integration to CI/CD pipeline, automation, and management systems
Pre-migratory pen-testing and security reporting, load testing, and failure/high-availability testing
Documentation preparation for Operations staff, Development staff, and Management

outcomes: Successfully deployed market-leading SaaS platform serving 500+ global insurance company clients across 15 countries with 99.5% platform uptime
